ADDED i2: Tag lookup is case-insensitive: "script" and "SCRIPT" resolve to equal tags.

Additionally, tags resolved from the same {@link TagSet} are cached, so repeate
ADDED i3: Tag.valueOf resolves against a shared HTML TagSet; differing case yields equal tags.
ADDED i4: Resolving from a single TagSet caches by normalised name, so we get the same instance back.
ADDED i5: The {@code } tag is an inline, self-closing (void) element and is therefore not a block.
